status.scope_reason: The company is headquartered in the United States and commercially markets an FDA-approved generic formulation of sacubitril/valsartan (generic Entresto) tablets.
status.evidence: According to Drugs.com, FDA-approved generic versions of Entresto (sacubitril/valsartan) are available from manufacturers including Zydus.

claims.claim: Zydus Lifesciences Limited received final approval from the US Food and Drug Administration (USFDA) on July 10, 2024, to market its generic version of finished sacubitril and valsartan combination formulations.
Zydus's USFDA approval spans the oral film-coated tablet dosage form across three standard strengths: 24 mg/26 mg, 49 mg/51 mg, and 97 mg/103 mg.

Zydus Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. is listed as the packager for FDA-approved human prescription drug labels of sacubitril and valsartan tablets across NDC codes 70710-1272, 70710-1273, and 70710-1274. DailyMed (.gov) +2 If you wish,
The company reports that its generic sacubitril and valsartan tablets are produced at the group's formulation manufacturing facility in Moraiya, Ahmedabad, India.

The company reports that its U.S. affiliate network is backed by 8 FDA-approved finished dosage sites globally, with the designated Moraiya plant executing manufacturing operations under ANDA No. 213719.
claims.note: U.S. affiliate network backed by 8 FDA-approved finished dosage sites globally
claims.source: Zydus Lifesciences Press Release (July 10, 2024) / DailyMed Product Label

claims.claim: An independent regulatory tracking report indicates that the U.S. FDA inspected the company’s Moraiya manufacturing plant between October 5 and October 13, 2026, and flagged five specific process observations.

The parent company Zydus Lifesciences Limited received final USFDA approval to market Sacubitril and Valsartan Tablets (24 mg/26 mg, 49 mg/51 mg, and 97 mg/103 mg) on July 10, 2024, as reported in a company investor press release.

Zydus Lifesciences Limited received final regulatory approval from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) on July 10, 2024, under Abbreviated New Drug Application (ANDA) number 213719, to market generic Sacubitril and Valsartan Tablets in 24 mg/26 mg, 49 mg/51 mg, and 97 mg/103 mg strengths.
